escape_asterisks off leaves asterisks in a table cell unescaped

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"escape_asterisks\":false}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td>2*3 = 6</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
